name: Olly's Baked Assortments
notes: Single photo of a self-serve cookie honesty-box stand. Cookie flavor names read from the 'O.B.A Cookie Line Up' poster and shelf labels; only two shelf labels had a legible price ($3 each). The general bundle pricing sign (1 cookie $2, 3 for $5, 6 for $10, baker's dozen $20) is per-quantity, not per-item, so it was omitted from dish prices.
